name: @afl-lang/core
description: TypeScript toolkit and reference virtual machine for Agent Flow Language IR

scripts.test:cli: node bin/afl.mjs validate test/fixtures/echo.afl && node bin/afl-vm.mjs test/fixtures/noop-bindings.mjs test/fixtures/minimal.afl
scripts.smoke:deepseek: npm run build && node bin/afl-vm.mjs examples/deepseek-bindings.mjs examples/live-smoke.afl
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:cli && npm run test:package
